watches.name: Bukhara:  Automatic
watches.description: The dial of the Bukhara timepiece is derived from an interior dome of the central mosque complex of the city of Bukhara - the fabled Po-i-Kaylan built in 1514. The tan and brown crisscrossing pattern evokes the trodden earthen pathways of the Silk Roads which defined the city of Bukhara for centuries. A city that was a meeting point for scholars, travelers, merchants and artisans. Darkened at the edges - the appearance of the dial evokes standing at the center of a dome and looking upward. Evoking the sense of awe and peace from standing within the Maasjid itself. The clear display caseback is marked with the iconic Kalyan Minaret originally built in 1127 by emperor Mohammad Arslan Khan. The tower was famously spared by Mongol invaders and remains as testament to the strength and resilience of the city. The display caseback reveals a custom engraved blue rotor - colored in tribute to the Zerafshan River - which made the fertility of this oasis city possible. watches.name: Zafaaran : Peace & Freedom Edition
watches.description: The pattern on the beautiful Zafaraan timepiece is derived from the intricate tilework of Hisham’s Palace at Jericho - located in the modern West Bank. Built in the 8th century during the Umayyad era, the palace—also known as Khirbat al-Mafjar—is home to some of the largest and best-preserved mosaic pavements in the world. Rendered in a stunning sunburst hue, the watch’s name and color are a tribute to Palestinian Saffron - a traditional spice harvested for generations particularly among the mountains and valleys of the Nablus region. The case back features an emblem of an olive tree filled with birds with the words of Palestinian poet Marwan Makhoul engraved above it: "In order to hear the birds, the warplanes must be silent." Imbued with mission - $50 of every purchase with be contributed to the Palestine Children's Relief Fund (www.pcrf.net) contributing to the direct aid and welfare of Palestinian children. watches.name: The Heart of Design
watches.description: Castle and Gazelle is proud to present The Heart of Design Timepiece - a collaboration with design leader and entrepreneur Peter Gould that celebrates a heart-centered philosophy of design. Peter’s stunning calligraphic motif interweaves 6 elements of Islamic wisdom into an 8-sided star - a visual celebration of timeless spiritual principles to inspire your journey: Ridaa رِضَا - Contentment Ikhlas الْإِخْلَاص - Integrity Barakah بركة - Blessing Niyyah نِيَّةٌ - Intentionality Ihsan إحسان - Excellence Amanah أمانة - Trust The watch features a polished gently slanted front bezel, an engraved crown and case back and features applied lume on the hands and indices. A textured charcoal granola leather strap completes the piece. We hope this timepiece serves as a centering reminder of these principles rooted Islamic tradition and is an inspiration for the wearer. Peter Gould’s Gould Studio is based in Sydney, Jakarta, Dubai and Beirut and offers coursework in Peter’s The Heart of Design philosophy. watches.name: Zellij Sitara : Automatic
watches.description: Introducing the Zellij Sitara زليج سِتَار A star motif floats above an visible Eastern Arabic date wheel - white indices over a slate gray ring complete the dial that provides a contrast between modern and traditional design elements. In addition to highlighting the beauty of Arabic numerals - the dial is an exploration of the contrast between “fast” and “slow” time - the visible date wheel allows the viewer to consider the progression of days within the month. An awareness that has special meaning within the Islamic Lunar Calendar. The word Sitara سِتَار traditionally holds the dual meaning of both star and also veil or covering - as in the “veil of stars.” Applied lume on the hands, indices, dial and date wheel provides a striking appearance in low-light conditions. A polished front bezel, engraved crown and black or olive brown granola leather strap completes the package. “No one knows the Great Pattern the Wheel weaves. We can only watch, and study, and hope. ” - Robert Jordan Specifications: Case Size: 39mm Case thickness: 11.7mm Case material: Stainless Steel Crown: 6.5mm Case Color: Silver Movement: Seiko NH35 Automatic Movement Glass: Sapphire Crystal Strap Width: 20mm Strap: Genuine Leather with Quick Release Mechanism Water Resistant: 5 ATM

watches.name: Azure Green : Automatic
watches.description: Our beautiful Azure Green is now available in an Automatic mechanical option. This piece features a dial derived from the stunning tilework pattern of the Jameh mosque in Yazd, Iran. A honeycomb of turquoise surrounds a intricate central disc of orange, green, blue and grey. Thin white hands and black hour marking complete the design. From Islamic Art by Luca Mozzati: “Plunged into a sea of bright greenish blue, the mihrab hall in the Jameh mosque at Yazd boasts a series of ceramic medallions in a narrow range of white-turquoise-blue-brown shades that shimmer over a surface of hexagonal tiles of light, watery green. The central point is the motif that generates the entire composition from it, in accordance with flawless geometrical plan and through two six-pointed stars, there radiates out a rigorous and compact design underscored by a delicately floral impulse based on a rhythmical twelvefold modulation. The combination of rationality and lyricism seems intended to remind believers that in order to be receptive to the invisible concealed behind the visible, one must rely as much on emotional as on intellectual faculties.” Azure Green : Mechanical Edition Case Size: 39mm Case thickness: 11.7mm Case material: Stainless Steel Crown: 6.5mm Case Color: Silver Movement: Seiko NH35 Automatic Movement Glass: Sapphire Crystal Strap Width: 20mm Strap: Genuine Leather with Quick Release Mechanism Water Resistant: 5 ATM

watches.name: Samarkand Blue : Automatic
watches.description: The majestic pattern of the Samarkand Blue is derived from one of the interior domes of the Registan Square in the city of Samarkand, Uzbekistan. The blue-white variegated pattern at the center fades to inky black at the dial periphery. Hands and hour markers in white complete this striking design. The Registan Square, also known as the Registan Ensemble or Registan Complex, is one of the most iconic and historic architectural landmarks in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. It is a magnificent public square adorned with three grand madrasas (Islamic schools) known for their stunning Islamic architecture and intricate tilework. The name "Registan" translates to "Sandy Place" in Persian, referring to the square's historical location on the ancient Silk Road. The Registan Square has played a central role in the history of Samarkand. It was a bustling center for trade, culture, and scholarship during the Silk Road era. Today, it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a symbol of Uzbekistan's rich cultural heritage. Our new Winter 2024 edition includes the following improvements: a slanted front bezel for a slimmer profile, applied lume to hands and indices, and an engraved crown. watches.name: Zellij Moonlight Edition
watches.description: We're happy to offer a stunning black and grayscale variant of our popular Zellij model. The pattern on the beautiful Zellij Moonlight Edition is derived from the stonework of the fountains of the Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca, Morocco. The beautifully rendered 3D printed dial is mean to evoke the serenity and majesty of a moonlit night sky. Its name is a tribute to Zellij a distinctive style of tilework or mosaic art that is commonly found in Islamic architecture, particularly in North Africa - Morocco, Tunisia and Algeria. Skilled artisans carefully cut and arranged each tile by hand, creating stunning and mesmerizing designs. The word "zillīj" (زليج) is derived from the verb "zalaja" (زَلَجَ) meaning "to slide."
